evidence.note: Title slide is clean: large serif headline, muted sans subtitle, italic byline, soft background blobs; generous whitespace, nothing colliding.
Triangle loop diagram (model, environments, scorer) with colour-coded honest/cheat arrows and check badges; definition tile sits directly under the diagram it explains; uncluttered.
Insight card overlays a blurred slide; same Insight treatment recurs on s-4 step 7 and s-5 step 9, consistent component.

Numbered timeline, server panel with agent swarm fan-in to package mirror, and a source-labelled quote tile; consistent text hierarchy, no collisions, though the right third above the quote tile is empty.
Coordinator tree card is tidy, but blurred ghosts of the legend ('Agent Run') and the timeline edge show around and below the card.

Densest step: folder grid, scorer box, coordinator/sacrificed dots and a 'never read transcripts' label that sits on the server panel's bottom border, slightly busy; timeline column reaches near the legend.

Three evenly sized insight cards with serif heads, bullets, italic quote and linked sources; consistent styling, but blurred residue of the previous diagram and legend shows through behind/below the cards (around y~985).
Closing 'Thank you' mirrors the title slide treatment; consistent nav and chrome across all slides.

rationale: Typography, components (timeline, quote tiles, Insight overlay, cards) and chrome are consistent across every slide, and the diagrams carry the narrative purposefully with quotes placed beside what they narrate. The shortfalls are local: ghosted residue of prior content behind the s-5 programme card and s-9 cards, and a busier s-5 step 8 where the 'never read transcripts' label straddles the panel edge. That is considered throughout with one or two slides below the rest, level 4.
